name: Orc
source: One of the daemons of this world, most of them are illiterate and bad with money.[spoiler] In [url=/v10000]Kyonyuu Fantasy 2[/url], they make a living by robbing people since they are unable to pay the interest rates of money lenders.[/spoiler]
